Messages.Author: delangen
Messages.Body:
I was playing the Spiridonas turbo soul gem deck... he was pentex subverted and had the society of leopold on him, he was also equipped with the soul gem and had the fortitude master, making him 11cap....(also a side note I kept an extra spiirdonas in the uncontrolled region with 5 blood just in case)

My prey called a successfull banishment on him returning him to uncontrolled with 3 blood. So just to clarify the sequence of events: When I invest in the new Spiridonas the Pentex, Society, fortitiude and soul gem all transfer to him...correct?

Furthermore next untap I can burn him with the society of leopold drawing a new Spiridonas free of the pentex and society allthough with no fortitude but he still have the soul gem, right?

Thank you kindly

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> delangen wrote:
> I was playing the Spiridonas turbo soul gem deck... he was pentex subverted and had the society of leopold on him, he was also equipped with the soul gem and had the fortitude master, making him 11cap....(also a side note I kept an extra spiirdonas in the uncontrolled region with 5 blood just in case)
>
> My prey called a successfull banishment on him returning him to uncontrolled with 3 blood. So just to clarify the sequence of events: When I invest in the new Spiridonas the Pentex, Society, fortitiude and soul gem all transfer to him...correct?
>
Yes.

EDIT Maybe I didn't get that "new" word.
If you bring out a copy with no Pentex on him, then no Pentex is moved.
If you bring out a copy with a Pentex, a Society of Leopold, a Soul Gem, etc. on him, these cards are moved (merely faced up, but they just stay on him).

EDIT: Also, remember, Banishment can only be called on a younger vampire. Spiridonas with a Fortitude discipline being an 11-cap, it would require a 12+ cap calling the Banishment to be able to choose Spiridonas as the target (since Final Nights).
>
> Name: Banishment
> Cardtype: Political Action
> Choose a younger ready vampire. Successful referendum means that the chosen vampire is moved to the uncontrolled region (breaking any temporary control effects). The vampire is uncontrolled. Any cards and counters on that vampire stay with him or her (but they are out of play as long as the vampire remains uncontrolled).
>
> delangen wrote:
> Furthermore next untap I can burn him with the society of leopold drawing a new Spiridonas free of the pentex and society allthough with no fortitude but he still have the soul gem, right?
>
> Thank you kindly
>
> Name: Society of Leopold
> Cardtype: Master
> Unique master.
> Put this card on a vampire. During his or her controller's untap phase, the vampire with this card either burns 1 blood or is burned (the controller's choice). The vampire with this card can move it to any other vampire as a +1 stealth  action.
>
Sure, you can choose to let Spiridonas + Fortitude + Soul Gem (+Pentex, +whatever he might also have) burn to the Society of Leopold during your untap phase.

If the next crypt card is a Spiridonas, then he is moved to the ready region, with blood from the blood bank to match his capacity, and he gets the Soul Gem of Etrius.

> Name: Soul Gem of Etrius
> Cardtype: Equipment
> Unique equipment.
> If this vampire is burned, draw the top card from your crypt. If it is younger, put the Soul Gem on him or her and move him or her to your ready region with blood from the blood bank equal to his or her capacity; otherwise, move that card to your uncontrolled region (and burn the Soul Gem). If bearer is diablerized, the diablerizing vampire cannot take the Soul Gem.
>

Sure: "Any cards and counters on that vampire stay with him or her (but they are out of play as long as the vampire remains uncontrolled)." (quoted from Banishment's text).

Maybe it should be made clearer in the rules that, when a minion is influenced out (vampire or imbued), any cards / counters on him or her in the uncontrolled region are also moved (and put face up, in case of cards). That text on Banishment seemed clear enough to me, but if it isn't, the Rules will have to be adapted.

All cards stay on the exact copy of the minion that is banhished. So you would have 1 copy of Spiridonnas with 3 blood and Pentex et.al., and you would have 1 copy of Spiridonnas with 5 blood and no other cards as well.

If you influence the version where 5 blood are already on it, no cards are moved, Spiridonnas will enter play with no cards on him.

That's the interesting part of the situation presented.
They stay on the minion, by the Banishment text.
Yet, the original post implied existance of two Spiridonases. And the one influenced was not the one banished. Nonetheless, both master cards and a minion card migrated to the newly influenced vampire.
The question is if they check for a particular copy of a minion, or just the minion itself (by its name).

Ah, right. I got confused with the "new" word.

If Spiridonas the Banished (the one on whom Pentex Subversion, Society of Leopold, etc. were played), is influenced out, these cards that were on him are actually still on him.

If Spiridonas "from crypt" (not the Banished one) is influenced out, no cards move to him. He's just a vampire who got influenced out.

Thanks Amenophobis - I edited the post above to make it clearer

Messages.Body:
It would kind of make sense that even any Methuselah who invests in the control of any Spiridonas would then have to deal with the boon or bane of any cards on him, since the banishment says that:

•A Banished vampire will remember all effects that had been applied to him, just as contested vampires do. This includes gained or lost titles, etc. [RTR 20000501]
•Note that "for the rest of the game" effects pointing at the Banished vampire (from some other source) will resume if/when the vampire comes back into play (e.g., Contract naming that Assamite). [TOM 19960210]

I thought this was the spirit of contention and uniqueness,

Another example lets say vampire1 has the society of leopold after him and is equipped with, let's say an ivory bow. Another methusleah invest in the control of a copy vampire1 in his/her uncontroled ragion and brings them out contesting them. I know that the rules say otherwise but it would make sense that if the second methuselah were to win control of vampire1 the bow and the society would still belong to vamp1, since they represent the same vampire in the world...his bow shouldn't just magically burn and the society shouldn't stop chasing him just because he took a little (contested) vacation.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answers from jamesatzephyr and Ankha.

Cards out of play (such as cards in your library, cards in your hand, contested cards, cards in your uncontrolled area, or in your ash heap - or removed from the game) have no effect.
